content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Reno

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: The PMP® credential requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific requirements for your background—secondary degree holders and bachelor's degree holders face different thresholds. Granite PM Academy's advisors can clarify whether your experience qualifies before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP® prep course. Attend sessions on your schedule from anywhere; no commute required. Active certified practitioners lead real-world case studies and exam-focused instruction across all five process groups, ensuring you grasp both theory and application.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your 35 contact hours, formally apply to PMI with proof of your education and project experience. Pay the exam eligibility fee directly to PMI. Granite PM Academy guides you through the online application portal and answers questions about documentation requirements.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, domain breakdowns, and instructor Q&A sessions—to build confidence. Schedule your exam at a Pearson VUE testing center in the Reno area. Sit for the computer-based PMP® exam when you feel ready; no artificial deadline pressure.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) over a standard three-year renewal cycle to keep your PMP® active. Granite PM Academy offers PDU-eligible courses and webinars. Renew your credential with PMI before expiration to maintain the competitive edge in your local job market.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
